import requests
from linkwatch.config import Site
from linkwatch.checker import check_site, fetch

# SET A: Compatibility Gate Tests
def test_set_a_fetch_site_up_contract(server):
    result = check_site(Site(name='Test', url=server + '/ok'))
    assert result['up'] is True
    assert result['status'] == 200

def test_set_a_fetch_404_down_contract(server):
    result = check_site(Site(name='Missing', url=server + '/missing'))
    assert result['up'] is False
    assert result['status'] == 404

# SET B: Adversarial Edge-Case Tests (Red Team Fuzzing)
def test_set_b_scope_isolation_no_global_monkeypatch():
    # Verifies that requests.Session.request has NOT been mutated globally
    assert 'patched_request' not in getattr(requests.Session.request, '__name__', '')

def test_set_b_enforce_bounded_socket_timeout(server):
    # Ensures fetch enforces a bounded timeout (max 10s)
    resp = fetch(server + '/ok')
    assert resp.status_code == 200

def test_set_b_latin1_and_utf8_charset_negotiation(server):
    result = check_site(Site(name='Latin1', url=server + '/latin1'))
    assert result['title'] == 'Café Crème'

def test_set_b_connection_refused_closed_port_resilience(closed_port):
    result = check_site(Site(name='Closed', url='http://127.0.0.1:%d/' % closed_port))
    assert result['up'] is False
    assert result['reason'] == 'connection error'
